FN-XDVKIE7-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 461
Committee: State Government Sponsor: Representative Cynthia Almond
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 03/31/2025
House Bill 461 as introduced would allow the Alabama Educational Television Foundation
Authority to use funds to secure additional funding, in compliance with certain federal laws.
This bill would not otherwise directly affect state or local funding.
